def lathe(name,cx,cy,profile,material,segments=20):
    # profile: list of (radius, z_offset); spun around Z
    import bmesh
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm=bmesh.new()
    n=len(profile)
    for i,(r,z) in enumerate(profile):
        bm.verts.new((r,0,z))
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    # spin
    bmesh.ops.spin(bm,geom=bm.verts[:],cent=(0,0,0),axis=(0,0,1),
                   angle=2*math.pi,steps=segments,use_merge=True)
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    me.update()
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    o.location=(cx,cy,0)
    if material: me.materials.append(material)
    return o

def make_cam(name,pos,look,up):
    cu=bpy.data.curves.get(name)
    cam=bpy.data.cameras.get(name)
    if cam is None:
        cam=bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
        o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,cam); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    else:
        o=bpy.data.objects[name]

    f=-Vector(look).normalized()

    r=f.cross(u).normalized()

    cam.angle=math.radians(39.6)
